scenes.title: The drum guides clothes while water moves outward
Perforations and a pump remove the water
A balanced load enables a stable fast spin
Rotation and drainage dry the load

vo.text: This washing machine removes water from wet clothes by spinning the drum rapidly.
vo.speak: This washing machine removes water from wet clothes by spinning the drum rapidly.

vo.text: The clothes stay against the drum wall while water escapes.
vo.speak: The clothes stay against the drum wall while water escapes.

vo.text: The drum wall pushes inward on the clothes to keep them moving in a circle.
vo.speak: The drum wall pushes inward on the clothes to keep them moving in a circle.

vo.text: Water is not held in the same way, so it can move outward through the fabric.
vo.speak: Water is not held in the same way, so it can move outward through the fabric.

vo.text: The drum's small holes let that water pass into the outer tub.
vo.speak: The drum's small holes let that water pass into the outer tub.

vo.text: A pump then drains the water away while the clothes stay inside the perforated drum.
vo.speak: A pump then drains the water away while the clothes stay inside the perforated drum.

vo.text: A balanced load keeps the drum stable and lets it reach an effective spin speed.
vo.speak: A balanced load keeps the drum stable and lets it reach an effective spin speed.

vo.text: So rotation, perforations, and drainage remove water without squeezing the clothes.
